latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency: 11 cycles for 0/Inf/NaN/negative; 15 for exact squares 1, 4, 0.25 and minnorm; 54 for general inputs; 55 for maxsub; 16 for minsub. Measured with an integer-bit reset chain; 5 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. The sample experiment uses 1.0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: frsqrt.d $f0, $f8; frsqrt.d $f1, $f9; frsqrt.d $f2, $f10; frsqrt.d $f3, $f11; frsqrt.d $f4, $f12; frsqrt.d $f5, $f13; frsqrt.d $f6, $f14; frsqrt.d $f7, $f15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4' --asm 'frsqrt.d $f0, $f8; frsqrt.d $f1, $f9; frsqrt.d $f2, $f10; frsqrt.d $f3, $f11; frsqrt.d $f4, $f12; frsqrt.d $f5, $f13; frsqrt.d $f6, $f14; frsqrt.d $f7, $f15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput: CPI 6.0 for special values; 8.0 for exact squares; 27.5 for general inputs; 28.0 for maxsub; 8.5 for minsub. Throughput is initiation-interval bound.

notes: Latency 11-55 cycles and throughput CPI 6-28 are data-dependent; the stored experiments use representative operand samples.
